_comment: Workbook exercise air-economizer (docs/workbook/air-economizer.md): the lbnl-sdahu config template with the economizer rules only. `camber datasets config lbnl-sdahu --exercise air-economizer --store DIR --out cfg.json` fills in the store path. The unit's own design minimum OA (a 1.6% OA fraction at its fixed 10% minimum damper position) and its fixed 60 F dry-bulb high limit are the dataset template's (see configs/lbnl-sdahu.json); free_cooling_missed is added for the stuck-closed dampers, and leaking_valve is left to the air-heat-cool exercise.
